# Shiny Jets Directory

> The Shiny Jets Directory (https://directory.shinyjets.com) is a directory of aircraft detailers. Detailers who use the Shiny Jets CRM list themselves in the directory. Visitors can search by home airport and request a quote from each listing.

## About

- Listings are created and maintained by the detailers themselves through the Shiny Jets CRM.
- Each listing has a "Request a Quote" link that sends the request directly to that detailer.
- Shiny Jets CRM is software built by an aircraft detailer, for aircraft detailers.
- Shiny Jets was founded by Brett Berry, who has 18 years of experience detailing aircraft.

## Key URLs

- Directory home: https://directory.shinyjets.com/
- Detailer listings: https://directory.shinyjets.com/detailer/{slug}
- Detailers by state: https://directory.shinyjets.com/aircraft-detailers/{state} (for example /aircraft-detailers/california)
- Detailers by airport: https://directory.shinyjets.com/aircraft-detailers/{airport-code} (for example /aircraft-detailers/kvny)
- Sitemap: https://directory.shinyjets.com/sitemap.xml
- Contact: https://directory.shinyjets.com/contact
- Shiny Jets CRM (for detailers): https://crm.shinyjets.com
- Shiny Jets: https://shinyjets.com
